recovery.email.subject: Reset your {{.Tenant}} password
recovery.email.body:
Hello {{.Name}},

Someone asked to reset the password for your account ({{.Username}}). Open
this link to choose a new one:

{{.Link}}

The link works once and expires in {{.Minutes}} minutes. If this was not
you, no action is needed — the password has not changed.
verification.email.subject: Confirm your {{.Tenant}} account
verification.email.body:
Hello {{.Name}},

An account ({{.Username}}) was registered with this address on {{.Tenant}}.
Open this link to confirm the address and finish signing up:

{{.Link}}

The link works once and expires in {{.Hours}} hours. If you did not
register, no action is needed — the account cannot be used until somebody
opens that link.
